resources.string: Select numbered tiles so every row and column matches its outer target sum.
Each board shows row and column targets around the grid. Select the numbered cells that should count toward those totals.
A target is complete only when the selected cells in that row or column add up exactly to the number outside the board.
Every selected cell affects one row and one column. Build solutions that satisfy both at the same time, especially on taller 5x6, 5x7, and 5x8 boards.
Complete all row and column targets to clear the puzzle and roll into the next board. Time Attack rewards faster full-board solves.
Tap the 3 in the top row. It completes that row target.
Tap the 2 in the second row. This move completes the column target.
Tap the 4 in the third row. Practice ends and the real game starts.
